note: Revised from the new-species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the original describes the soldier and the two worker forms (major and minor worker) and records the alate as unknown. Figure numbers, type specimens and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown, darker anteriorly; antennae and legs yellowish brown; mandibles nearly black; labrum dark brown; pronotum pale brown, paler than the antennae; body pale yellow. Head sparsely setose; pronotum more setose, body densely so. Total body length about 5.3 mm. Head capsule long, subrectangular; sides slightly incurved; length with mandibles 2.5 mm, length to mandibular base 1.83 mm, width 0.88 mm; width less than half the head length, width/length ratio 0.48; in profile slightly concave medially; frons short, inclined at about 45°. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented; segments short and thick; segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus fairly distinctly delimited from the frons, darker in colour. Labrum wider than long; sides nearly straight; anterior margin narrowed, pointed medially (length 0.13 mm, width 0.26 mm). Mandibles very short, stout, coarsely serrate; about two-fifths of the head length; left mandible 0.70 mm, right mandible 0.69 mm, ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.382. Postmentum long, rod-shaped; waist slightly narrowed; waist long, narrowest between the maximum width and the posterior margin (length 1.20 mm, maximum width 0.33 mm, minimum waist width 0.18 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a shallow notch, posterior margin nearly straight (length 0.38 mm, width 0.58 mm). Mesonotum almost as wide as the pronotum, metanotum slightly wider; posterior margins of both slightly convex.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers dimorphic. Major worker: head pale yellow; postclypeus and antennae slightly paler than the head; legs and thorax milky white; abdomen semi-transparent, the gut contents visible through it. Head and body rather densely setose. Total body length 3.5 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, wider at the antennal insertions; length to the apex of the labrum 1.05–1.10 mm, to the mandibular base 0.80–0.85 mm, maximum width 0.85–0.88 mm. Antennae 13-segmented; segments short and thick, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus longer than half its width; length 0.25 mm, width 0.45 mm; anterior margin straight, posterior margin convex and extending into the frontal region. Labrum spatulate, wider than long. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin without a distinct notch, posterior margin straight; length 0.23–0.25 mm, width 0.45–0.50 mm. Minor worker: identical to the major worker except smaller. Total body length 3.2–3.5 mm, head length to the apex of the labrum 0.85–0.90 mm, head length to the mandibular base 0.68 mm, head width 0.75 mm, postclypeus length 0.23–0.25 mm, postclypeus width 0.40 mm, pronotum length 0.20–0.25 mm, pronotum width 0.44–0.50 mm.
